name: Starlink V2 Mini
note: Phase 3a example. Approximate public dimensions: flat bus ~4.1 x 2.7 m, two ~52 m2 solar arrays on short booms, gimbaled about the cross-track axis to track the sun. Body frame: +Z nadir, +X velocity, +Y = +Z x +X. Materials are preset estimates, calibrated in Phase 3c.

sources.subject: bus
sources.value: bus 4.1 x 2.7 m; nadir-pointing, +X along velocity (the attitude law is an estimate)
sources.source: Footprint: McDowell, planet4589.org/astro/starsim (V2 Mini: bus 4.1 x 2.7 m). Thickness 0.4 m and the velocity-aligned yaw: estimates.
McDowell, planet4589.org/astro/starsim (V2 Mini: solar array 4.1 x 12.8 m, one per wing). Boom offset 6.9 m from the bus centre: estimate.
